subject: E-Commerce
title: The Physical Comeback
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Physical Comeback usable.

hook.text: Amazon opened 40+ physical stores, then closed most of them. Going from online to offline is harder than the reverse.

buildup.text: Online-first brands like Warby Parker, Allbirds, and Glossier opened physical stores to grow beyond digital limits.

discovery.text: Physical stores serve as showrooms, return centers, and brand experiences.

twist.text: Allbirds stock dropped 97% from its IPO despite opening stores. Physical retail doesn't fix a struggling brand.

climax.text: The future is hybrid: online for convenience, physical for experience. Pure-play in either direction has limits.

punchline.text: Amazon closed stores, Allbirds crashed. Online brands going physical is harder.

quiz.question: Why do some online-first brands open physical stores?
options: Physical stores serve as showrooms, return centers, and solve the try-before-you-buy problem
